notes: Player stats for the vertical slice. move_speed_mps, dodge_burst_mps and dodge_cooldown_s mirror the private consts in Scripts/World/PlayerController.cs (MoveSpeed 5.0, DodgeBurstSpeed 12.0, DodgeCooldownSeconds 0.7) and dodge_duration_s mirrors DodgeDurationSeconds (0.15) — if the code consts change, update these to match (code is authoritative at runtime). sword_damage 1 matches SwordHitbox.SwingDamage. hp_max 6 with hp_per_heart 1 = 6 heart containers; enemy damage 1 removes one heart, boss damage 2 removes two. Dodge gives ~1.8 m of burst travel (12.0 m/s * 0.15 s) on a 0.7 s cooldown — enough to clear a skeleton charge. Player outspeeds every enemy (fastest non-boss is skeleton at 3.5 m/s).
